subject: MAP: deployment lane selection and geo sequencing for Aperture Health
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Erica Morales <erica@aperturehealth.com>, procurement@aperturehealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff — deployment lane selection and geo sequencing

Hi Erica / Procurement team,

Thanks for the time on Wednesday. Per our discussion, attached is a distilled Mutual Action Plan (Aperture_MAP_v2.xlsx) that captures the evaluation checkpoints we agreed on and the proposed close cadence to decide deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and the target region sequencing. High-level asks in this email:

- Confirm (by EOD Tue 13 Apr) your operational constraints that force a Private/VPC requirement (regulation, data residency, on-prem constraints). If none, we can treat Dedicated as the likely enterprise lane.
- Share the security team's primary redlines against our SOC2 & encryption posture; we attached the security questionnaire for their convenience.
- Flag any calendar blackout dates in late April / early May that would make the demo/canary window infeasible.

Proposed evaluation plan highlights (see sheet "Eval Plan"):
- Week 1 (Apr 12–16): Technical discovery + data flow diagram + perf baseline on hosted sample.
- Week 2 (Apr 19–23): Dedicated capacity sizing exercise OR Private deployment viability assessment (network and KMS).
- Week 3 (Apr 26–30): Security attestation gap closure + canary planning.
- Target decision: week of May 3 — pick deployment mode and region for staggered rollouts (primary US-East, fallback US-West).

Notes on tradeoffs we discussed: if PCI/PHI scope drives Private, expect 6–8 week private onboarding; Dedicated is typically 2–3 weeks once contracts complete; Hosted is immediate but may need SSO & data segregation guardrails.

Next steps from Redwood: Karthik will sketch the Dedicated sizing & on-prem checklist; Priyom will coordinate the MAP milestones and hubspot tasks. Grace will follow up on legal/contracting items and a short demo slot.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation so we can lock the timeline.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Aperture_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP workbook), security-questionnaire-aperture.pdf (security stub)
From: Erica Morales <erica@aperturehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aperturehealth.com, Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@aperturehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — deployment lane selection and geo sequencing

Thanks Grace — appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers / clarifications: 

- Regulatory: Aperture does process limited PHI for care summaries; we would prefer to avoid a full Private deployment unless necessary. Our preference is Dedicated in a US region with encrypted-at-rest keys we control.
- Security: Jacob (cc'd) and procurement will run the questionnaire this week and come back with any gaps. Jacob: can you confirm whether your team needs an HSM integration or if KMIP/KMS with customer-managed keys is sufficient?
- Calendar: We have a major clinical release week of Apr 26–30; that makes the proposed canary in that week risky. Can we shift the canary planning to May 3–7 instead?

Also, in terms of procurement timeline: if Dedicated pricing and SLA look good we'll aim to finish procurement by end of May. If Hosted is chosen we can accelerate.

Erica Morales
VP Product, Aperture Health
erica@aperturehealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Erica Morales <erica@aperturehealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — deployment lane selection and geo sequencing

Erica — thanks for the quick read. Short technical notes to help your security/infra team: 

- Dedicated: we'll provision a reserved GPU pool and a tenant-isolated runtime. Customer-managed keys supported via AWS KMS CMKs or Azure Key Vault; HSM via BYOK/HSM gateway is supported but adds 2–3 weeks for validations.
- Private: our private appliance requires open network ports for orchestration; on-prem installs need a pre-signed cert exchange and firewall rules. Estimate 6 weeks for standard on-prem packaging + audit.
- Hosted: supports token-scoped dataset isolation + optional per-customer prefix caching. For PHI scoping we recommend Dedicated with CMEK or Hosted with a contractual data-flow egress and retention policy.

Sizing ask: can Aperture share a 7-day representative request trace (token volumes, avg seq len, p95 latency target) so I can give a candidate dedicated pool size? If you prefer, we can run a short perf baseline on hosted using a synthetic trace.

I will add a short checklist to the MAP workbook with the KMS/HSM options and the network ports/flows.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Erica Morales <erica@aperturehealth.com>, Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@aperturehealth.com>, procurement@aperturehealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — deployment lane selection and geo sequencing

Thanks all — summary and next steps: 

1) Timeline adjustment: move canary planning out of Apr 26–30 to May 3–7 as requested. Decision target still week of May 3 (we'll finalize on May 4 if the procurement and security reviews land).
2) Action items for Aperture:
   • Jacob: share the security team's shortlist on KMS vs HSM by Wed Apr 14.
   • Procurement: confirm any contract-specific SLAs you need beyond our standard Dedicated plan.
   • Infra: send a 7-day sample trace or allow Redwood to run a hosted perf baseline.
3) Action items for Redwood:
   • Karthik: populate dedicated sizing options in MAP workbook and add HSM validation effort estimate.
   • Priyom: update HubSpot (link below) with milestone tasks and owners; create the demo invite for Apr 20 (technical deep dive) and May 6 (canary planning).
   • Grace: will prepare a redline-friendly SOW and send a single consolidated doc for procurement review by Apr 16.

If everyone is aligned I’ll lock the Drive folder and mark the milestones in HubSpot today. Please reply with any objections.

Best,
Grace
